name: AU Small Finance Bank Ltd
title: AU Small Finance Bank Ltd - 540611 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 profit ₹832 crores (+65% YoY) on NIM 5.96% and credit cost 0.6%, but management guides FY27 credit cost ~90bps, says Q4 ROA of 1.8% is not permanent, and flags cost of funds may have bottomed.

triggers.label: Cost of funds may have bottomed
triggers.quote: we think cost of funds may have bottomed

triggers.label: FY27 credit cost ~90bps
triggers.quote: we should build it around 90 bps or maybe in that range

triggers.label: Q4 ROA not permanent
triggers.quote: I don't think that 1.8 % this quarter ROA should be seen as our the permanent ROA

triggers.label: Deposits +23% YoY
triggers.quote: Deposits growth remained strong at 10% quarter -on-quarter and 23% Y-o-Y

guidance.quote: we should build it around 90 bps or maybe in that range
I believe next year, this current financial year, we should be lower than 4%
we believe our franchise is capable of sustainably compounding at 2 to 2.5 x of India's nominal GDP growth rate
the cost of money should be around the repo rate prevalent at that time

red_flags.label: Margin tailwinds reversing
red_flags.quote: cost of funds may have bottomed. And some of the seasonal factors which I spoke about

red_flags.label: Unsecured book shrinking YoY
red_flags.quote: On a Y-o-Y basis, unsecured portfolio declined by 1%.

red_flags.label: Contingency provision added in Q4
red_flags.quote: contingency provision creation of Rs. 21 crs during Q4

red_flags.label: Management number corrections on call
red_flags.quote: Our retail and stable money is around 70% (correct number is 80%)

evasions.quote: And I'm so sorry to not give any guidance around it. You have to give us some time.
I can't tell you, any guidance around it
But to get to some number is diff icult Nitin on this call.
I would say that it's too operational now.
